categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in customized apparel manufacturing and C2M (Customer-to-Manufacturer) industrial internet platform services. Main segments include: (1) Customized clothing production and sales through the C2M platform, serving both B2B clients (brands, designers, entrepreneurs) and C2C consumers; (2) C2M Industrial Internet Research Institute providing technology and platform services; (3) Other business segments including engineering renovation, management consulting, and cross-border e-commerce services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology is the AI Agent 'Enterprise Operating System' built on C2M industrial internet principles. Key technologies include: (1) AI-driven customized database system (containing pattern database, style database, process database, BOM database); (2) Intelligent measurement system (IMS) using AI to automatically measure body data from photos; (3) Intelligent clothing matching system (ICMS) for personalized recommendations; (4) Multiple integrated information systems (OMS, APS, MES, WMS, SCM, TGS) enabling data-driven production; (5) Mass customization manufacturing achieving 'one person one pattern, one garment one style, one piece one flow' with 7-day delivery cycles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are B2B merchants including domestic and international apparel brands, fashion designers, clothing entrepreneurs, and retailers with their own stores and brands. The company also serves C2C consumers through online platforms. End markets include customized menswear (suits, shirts, trousers, outerwear) and womenswear (tops, trousers, skirts, dresses, outerwear). Geographic markets span China (domestic) and international markets including the United States, Europe, and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Qingdao, Shandong Province. Key operating locations include Qingdao (headquarters and main manufacturing), Weifang (test factory for C2M platform), and Beijing (subsidiary for technology services). International presence includes subsidiaries in Hong Kong (Aijia International Investment Development Limited) and New York (Kutesmart New York Limited) for overseas sales and operations. Domestic revenue represented 56.98% of total revenue while overseas revenue represented 43.02% in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the apparel supply chain. It functions as a manufacturer and service provider, receiving orders from B2B clients and consumers, procuring raw materials (fabrics and accessories) from suppliers, manufacturing customized products, and delivering directly to end customers. The company maintains relationships with over 260 qualified fabric and accessory suppliers, with 40+ long-term strategic partners, enabling flexible sourcing for diverse customization needs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Advancing C2M industrial internet platform technology and AI Agent 'Enterprise Operating System' capabilities; (2) Expanding cross-industry and cross-category applications of the platform beyond apparel to 50+ industries serving 150+ enterprises; (3) Developing AI large model capabilities for intelligent design, matching, and inspection; (4) Building intelligent manufacturing clusters with advanced automation and 5G integration; (5) Enhancing digital governance systems and data-driven decision-making; (6) Expanding product categories and market reach while maintaining focus on personalized customization and quality.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through: (1) Direct sales of customized apparel products to B2B clients (brands, designers, entrepreneurs) and C2C consumers, accounting for 94.85% of revenue through direct channels; (2) Franchise/affiliate sales through partner retailers (5.11% of revenue); (3) Minimal online direct-to-consumer sales (0.03% of revenue); (4) Ancillary services including engineering renovation, management consulting, and technology services. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of product control to customers, with domestic sales recognized upon delivery and export sales recognized upon customs clearance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in the emerging mass customization apparel segment with significant competitive advantages. Key competitors include other customization service providers and traditional apparel manufacturers entering the customization space. The company's competitive positioning is strengthened by: (1) 15+ years of accumulated customization expertise and data; (2) Proprietary AI-driven customization database and intelligent systems; (3) Proven ability to deliver customized products at industrial scale with 7-day turnaround; (4) Leadership in industry standards (20+ national standards participation); (5) Recognition as a national high-tech enterprise and industry benchmark; (6) Established customer base and brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 708.6 million yuan, representing a 5.14% decline from 2023's 746.9 million yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 88.6 million yuan in 2024 (down 20.71% from 111.8 million yuan in 2023). Total assets reached 1.57 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company has shown overall growth trajectory from 2022 (616.4 million yuan revenue) through 2023, with 2024 experiencing contraction due to market conditions and asset disposals. Operating cash flow remained healthy at 160 million yuan in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core value proposition centers on enabling mass customization at industrial scale and cost. Key differentiators include: (1) 'One person one pattern, one garment one style' capability delivering personalized products with 7-day delivery; (2) Elimination of inventory risk through demand-driven production model; (3) Low-cost customization through AI-driven automation and data optimization; (4) Comprehensive supply chain integration from design through delivery; (5) Proprietary AI Agent operating system enabling data-driven enterprise management; (6) Ability to serve diverse customer needs from individual consumers to enterprise brands; (7) Proven track record with 15+ years of customization expertise and accumulated data assets.
